subject: Request: C-suite clearance for liability waiver + customer discount ask

Subject: Updated redlines + commercial request (20% discount + liability carveout)

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the productive demo last week. Our procurement team reviewed Redwood's standard terms and pushed back on a couple of items we need to clear to move forward quickly:

- Liability cap: we need the cap removed for claims arising from data breaches impacting our customers (we can provide a scoped definition).
- Indemnity: request to broaden to cover third-party IP claims without a knowledge threshold.
- Warranty: request to extend warranty period to 120 days for model performance SLA.
- Commercial: to offset our perceived risk we're asking for a 20% one-time onboarding credit applied to first 12 months.

I attached our redline (EdgeWave_Redline_v3.pdf) and a revised SOW excerpt. Can we get an internal route-to-approval and approximate timeline? Procurement has a March 29 go/no-go.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — Samir

--

Laura / Dev — forwarding EdgeWave's redline and commercial ask. Summary below:

- They want liability cap removed for data-breach-related customer claims (material change).
- They want indemnity broadened for third-party IP (no knowledge/time limit).
- Warranty period extended to 120 days for model performance; they propose service credits.
- Commercial ask: 20% onboarding credit for first 12 months.

My read: we can consider increasing cap and narrowing indemnity language, but full waiver is high risk. Pricing-wise 20% is steep; a compromise of 10–15% plus conditional protections might work.

Requesting C-suite clearance for any change to liability cap > $1M or commercial concessions > 10%. If we get leadership OK, legal will prepare a counter-redline to preserve our core protections (insurance requirement, incident notification SLA, revert-to-standard on renewal).

Can you review and advise fastest path? Procurement timeline: 2028-03-29.

Thanks,
Aisha

Subject: RE: Fwd: Updated redlines + commercial request (20% discount + liability carveout)

Aditya — looping you in since this hits both commercial and legal risk thresholds. Quick bullets:

- Ask: remove liability cap for data-breach customer claims; broaden indemnity; extend warranty; 20% onboarding credit.
- Suggested commercial compromise: 12% onboarding credit, temporary liability cap increase to $3M for first 12 months tied to our incident response/insurance proof, indemnity limited to direct damages and willful infringement, warranty limited to 60 days with service credits.
- Time pressure: EdgeWave needs decision by 3/29.

Can you confirm whether we can authorize the suggested compromise (12% / $3M / insurance + reversion at renewal) or should we deny? If approved, legal (Dev) will generate redline and Finance will confirm P&L impact.

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-18T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Updated redlines + commercial request (20% discount + liability carveout)

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed the proposed compromise and provide authorization with the following mandatory conditions:

1) Discount: approve up to a 12% one-time onboarding credit applied to invoices for the first 12 months only. No change to our list pricing beyond that.
2) Liability cap: approve a temporary increase to $3,000,000 (from standard $1,000,000) limited to claims directly arising from our SaaS platform incidents impacting EdgeWave customers, and only for the initial 12-month term. We do NOT waive cap permanently.
3) Indemnity: accept narrowed indemnity limited to third-party IP claims for which we have knowledge and that arise from our model or code; exclude broad negligence/unknown claims.
4) Warranty: limit warranty extension to 60 days with service-credit remedies (not monetary damages).
5) Pre-conditions: EdgeWave must provide an insurance certificate (cyber liability >= $5M) and agree to incident response timelines and forensics cooperation.
6) Renewal clause: contract must revert to Redwood standard T&Cs at renewal unless leadership explicitly re-authorizes otherwise.

Dev / Legal: please draft the counter-redline reflecting the language above and include the insurance clause and audit/forensics requirement. Laura / Finance: model the 12% concession impact for the ARR first year; confirm acceptance.

If the above is acceptable, Aisha, send the counter with attachments and propose a clean-up call to close before 3/29.

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
CEO | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Updated redlines + commercial request (20% discount + liability carveout)

Samir — thanks for the patience. We discussed internally and can move forward subject to the compromises below (attached counter-redline):

- Commercial: Redwood will offer a one-time 12% onboarding credit applied against invoices during the first 12 months.
- Liability cap: temporary increase to $3,000,000 limited to direct claims arising from Redwood platform incidents impacting EdgeWave customers for the initial 12-month term. This is a temporary concession and the contract will revert to standard cap at renewal unless leadership authorizes otherwise.
- Indemnity: wording narrowed to third-party IP claims tied to our code/model where we had actual knowledge; we cannot accept a broad, knowledge-free indemnity.
- Warranty: extended to 60 days with defined service-credit remedies (no additional monetary damages).
- Preconditions: EdgeWave to provide cyber insurance certificate (>= $5M), acceptance of our incident response timeline, and cooperation for any forensics.

Attached: Redwood_CounterRedline_EdgeWave_v1.pdf (redline), SOW_ExhibitA_final.docx.

If EdgeWave accepts these items, we can finalize the contract and book the implementation kickoff. Happy to schedule a 30-minute call to walk the redline.

Best,
Aisha
